_comment: Release-gate thresholds for the scoreboard (ENT-S3). TARGET set by the owner: 99 % on what the system accepts on its own (precision, CER, WER, context). NOTHING has been measured on real handwriting, so this gate BLOCKS until a labelled real-handwriting set passes it. 'Accepted' = values the system stands behind without a person; every other value goes to a person to confirm.
